t: 60 Minutes - Luxottica. Do you know who makes your glasses?

q.x: These are really just design houses that aggregate brand names and manufacture largely in China. [link] is a great watch if you have time.

desc:
Think RayBan and Chanel Sunglasses are still made of good quality? Watch the 60 Minutes piece on the optical industries empire, Luxottica. Revealing how Luxottica has cornered the industry buying up eyewear collections that use to be independent and converting them to mass produced glasses. Here is a list of Luxottica brands and retailers.

Luxottica Brands:
Ray-Ban
Oakley
Chanel
Bulgari
Dolce & G

recs.stt: Google Deal With Luxottica Will Bring Glass to Ray-Ban, Oakley
recs.x:
These are really just design houses that aggregate brand names and manufacture largely in China.

 [link] is a great watch if you have time. Nothing too surprising to those that understand where this stuff comes from, but certainly interesting to see it laid out.
